summary: Preserved the candidate's request-local row chunking and mapping fixes, and added a pre-allocation guard so an atomic request-local fp32 logits row can no longer silently exceed the computed memory budget.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before on the exact candidate: fp8_mqa_logits returned a 40-byte GPU fp32 output row against a 4-byte budget. Raw output: candidate-counterexample-before.log.

12 passed after correction. The exact 40-byte/4-byte case raises before DeepGEMM is called; feasible RAGGED/PAGED, exact-fit, empty-K, padding, and adjacent budget cases pass. Raw output: regression-after.log.

gpu_evidence: One AMD Instinct MI350X (gfx950), PyTorch 2.11.0+rocm7.2, HIP 7.2.26015; real GPU FP8 and metadata tensors with mocked DeepGEMM/top-k orchestration.
remaining_limitations: No GLM-5.3-Flash or RadixArk model weights were available.
The original four-B300 CUDA TP=4/EP=4 serving workload, hierarchical cache, DFLASH traffic, and NVIDIA allocation behavior were not reproduced.
DeepGEMM and fused top-k were mocked, so actual NVIDIA kernels and end-to-end semantic accuracy remain unverified.

An atomic request-local row larger than the budget is rejected before allocation; computing it within that budget would require a K-splittable logits/top-k interface with globally correct score merging.
No native files changed, so a native rebuild was not applicable.
